results.title: Privacy in consumer wearable technologies: a living systematic ...
results.content: In this study, we systematically evaluated the privacy policies of 17 leading wearable technology manufacturers using a novel rubric comprising 24 criteria across seven dimensions: transparency, data collection purposes, data minimization, user control and rights, third-party data sharing, data security, and breach notification. The evaluation revealed significant variability in privacy and data security practices across wearable device companies, with certain criteria demonstrating a high prevalence of risks.
